title: About Us
summary: Art of Menu is QR menu, table ordering, inventory and smart pricing software for restaurants, cafés and bars. It is developed and sold by Göktigin Bilişim Teknoloji Ltd. Şti. in Antalya, Türkiye.

blocks.p: Art of Menu is a software product of **Göktigin Bilişim Teknoloji Limited Şirketi**, based at the Akdeniz University Uluğbey R&D building in Antalya. We help food and beverage businesses move their menus online, serve guests in their own language and make daily decisions with data.
Art of Menu is not a separate legal entity; the provider of the service and the seller of subscriptions is Göktigin Bilişim Teknoloji Ltd. Şti.
Art of Menu is cloud software (SaaS) sold to businesses on a subscription basis, with three plans per branch:

ul: **Menu:** multilingual QR menu, product photos, allergen information, PDF menu, the business's own domain.
**Order:** everything in Menu plus table ordering, the waiter screen and waiter/water/bill calls.
**Smart:** everything in Order plus daily smart pricing, weather-based menu ordering, product suggestions, recipe-based stock and sales reports.

blocks.p: Current prices are listed in the [Pricing](https://artofmenu.com/#plans) section of the home page.

Subscriptions start by creating an account at [app.artofmenu.com](https://app.artofmenu.com). Payments are taken by credit or debit card through the licensed payment institution **iyzico**; card details are never stored on Art of Menu servers.

The service is fully digital and nothing is shipped. Delivery, cancellation and refund terms are in [Delivery and Refund Terms](doc:delivery-returns); sales terms are in the [Distance Sales Agreement](doc:distance-sales) and the [Business Service Agreement](doc:business-terms).
